ev.q: Thirteen confirmed and three probable cases were reported during August 12–December 18, 2019.
KCHCSD and the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) initiated a joint investigation.

methods_quotes.q: A review of approximately 27,000 gonorrhea cases from the preceding 18 months revealed no other location or time clustering of disseminated gonococcal infection in Michigan.
A probable case was defined as a positive nucleic acid amplification test from nonsterile sites
